title: Flight itinerary attributes
description: Service-defined attributes for one scheduled passenger flight itinerary.

operating_carrier.title: Operating carrier
operating_carrier.description: IATA airline designator for the carrier operating the flight.

flight_number.title: Flight number
flight_number.description: Carrier-assigned flight number without the carrier designator.

included_checked_bags.title: Included checked bags
included_checked_bags.description: Number of checked bags included before traveler-specific exceptions.

refundable.title: Refundable
refundable.description: Whether the advertised fare class permits a refund under its referenced fare rules.

airport.title: Airport
airport.description: IATA location code for the airport.

scheduled_at.title: Scheduled time
scheduled_at.description: Scheduled event time including its UTC offset.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: Terminal label supplied by the airport or carrier.
